## Your Systems. Working Together.

### Your HR Systems

**Continuous listening that runs on live data from every system you use**

Keep employee records, organizational structures, and demographics up to date with prebuilt connectors for Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, and Oracle HCM, plus ATS and LMS integrations. If a prebuilt connector isn’t an option, use SFTP or a custom connection.

[Find Your Integrations](https://go.perceptyx.com/platform/integrations#directory)

### Your AI Assistants

**Equip every leader to act on their team’s feedback**

Give leaders answers grounded in their own team’s listening data, right inside the AI assistants they already use (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) or agents your organization builds.

[Explore Perceptyx MCP](https://go.perceptyx.com/platform/mcp)

### Your Business Tools

**Connect employee insights to everyday decisions**

Use the Perceptyx API and webhooks to bring listening data into Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, and your data warehouse. See employee experience alongside operational, customer, and financial data.

[Visit the Developer Portal](https://go.perceptyx.com/developer-portal)

Use Cases

## Reach Your People Where They Work

![Move beyond the annual census](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/integrations/move-beyond-the-annual-census.jpg?width=364&height=364&name=move-beyond-the-annual-census.jpg)

### Move beyond the annual census

**Move beyond the annual census**Continuous listening requires a dynamic view of your organization. A live HRIS feed ensures your hierarchy, reporting structure, and demographic data are always up to date.

![Capture pre-hire insights](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/integrations/capture-pre-hire-insights.jpg?width=364&height=364&name=capture-pre-hire-insights.jpg)

### Capture pre-hire insights

**Capture pre-hire insights**Bring candidate feedback into your listening program for a more holistic view of the employee journey.

![Make participation easier](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/integrations/make-participation-easier.jpg?width=364&height=364&name=make-participation-easier.jpg)

### Make participation easier

**Make participation easier**Drive higher response rates by delivering survey invitations and reminders in the messaging apps and tools where people spend their time.

![Keep action moving](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/integrations/keep-action-moving.jpg?width=364&height=364&name=keep-action-moving.jpg)

### Keep action moving

**Keep action moving**Bring report-ready alerts and behavioral nudges into everyday workflows so employees and managers know when to take the next step.

![Include frontline and deskless teams](https://go.perceptyx.com/hs-fs/hubfs/integrations/include-frontline-and-deskless-teams.jpg?width=364&height=364&name=include-frontline-and-deskless-teams.jpg)

### Include frontline and deskless teams

**Include frontline and deskless teams**Reach everyone in the organization by extending access beyond the desk. Employees can take surveys through supported kiosks, timecard platforms, and shift-scheduling tools.

## Build the future of work with Perceptyx Anywhere

Your integrations are a starting point. Perceptyx Anywhere gets you to the next step, bringing not just data but decades of employee experience intelligence into the AI tools you use and build.

[Learn More Here](https://go.perceptyx.com/platform/perceptyx-anywhere)

## Built to integrate. Designed for trust.

Connect securely with SSO through Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, PingOne, and other SAML providers, using OAuth 2.0, or service account. Give your IT and security teams the resources they need to review how Perceptyx protects and processes employee data.

[Visit the Trust Center](https://go.perceptyx.com/security-trust-center)

## Need help finding the right fit?

Tell us which systems you use and what you want to accomplish. We’ll help you find the right way to connect.
